 Match Preview
 Women's Champions League - Game Week 5 Nov 19, 2026 - 15:00 Estadi Johan Cruyff Barcelona host Servette Women at the Estadi Johan Cruyff in the UEFA Women's Champions League, with Pere Romeu's side looking to build on a mixed run of results in both domestic and European competition.
 Barcelona enter this fixture sitting second in the Women's Champions League standings, a position that reflects their quality but also the pressure of keeping pace at the top of the table. Their most recent league phase result was a 1-1 draw with Arsenal Women, a match in which they dominated possession but were unable to find a winner.
 Servette arrive in a difficult moment. Cristian Toro Maspero's side are 14th in the Women's Champions League standings and have struggled for consistency, losing three of their last five matches in the competition. A heavy 8-0 defeat to Lyon and a 5-1 loss to HB Køge underline the gap they face against Europe's stronger clubs.
 Barcelona's recent Liga F form has also shown some vulnerability. A 1-1 draw with Deportivo de A Coruña last weekend interrupted what had been a strong domestic stretch, including a 5-1 win over Madrid Femenino and a 4-0 victory at FC Badalona.
 Servette did record a 5-1 win over Oud-Heverlee Leuven in late October, which stands as their standout result of the campaign so far. Whether they can replicate that performance against a Barcelona side playing at home is a different question entirely.
